title: Combine conformer thermodynamic contributions
summary: Combine conformer thermodynamic contributions. The contract registers the existing owner API and does not certify the accuracy of a particular molecular calculation.
gates: Require positive temperature and conformer degeneracies
All contributions use the same thermodynamic reference and units
Normalize populations and retain conformer identities
coordinate_policy: Preserve the ordered molecular identity, isotope masses, coordinate frame and declared owner representation; no geometry remapping or method substitution is implicit.
backend_policy: The scientific owner validates the inputs and numerical controls. Any missing electronic-structure acquisition uses the separately authorized calculation gateway; registration alone launches nothing.
